expectations.evidence: npm goes last, only after Maven resolves publicly

expectations.text: Rejects publishing the three registries in parallel

expectations.text: Treats a partial release as roll-forward: finish publishing, never unpublish the packages that made it

expectations.evidence: Both publish jobs skip versions that already exist
